prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in Houston, Texas, and has back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1389; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather just keep it to the accident, if that's okay.

Q: That's fine. We'll keep it brief. Can you confirm you were the driver of the vehicle involved in the parking lot collision in Houston?

A: Yes, I was driving. I'd just pulled into a spot at the shopping center off the main road.

Q: Okay. Can you describe what happened when the other vehicle made contact with you?

A: I was backing out of the space, and a car coming down the aisle didn't stop. Their front bumper hit my rear quarter panel. It wasn't a huge impact, but it jolted me pretty hard.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?

A: Not really. I glanced over my shoulder, but I didn't see it until it was already on me.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes, I always do.

Q: Did you seek medical attention after the collision?

A: Yes. I felt stiffness in my lower back that same evening, and it got worse overnight. I went to an urgent care clinic the next morning and they diagnosed a back strain.

Q: Are you still experiencing symptoms?

A: Yes. I'm having trouble sitting for long periods, and I've been taking over-the-counter pain relievers. My doctor has me doing physical therapy twice a week.

Q: Have you had any prior injuries or treatment to your back?

A: No, nothing serious. I had some minor soreness years ago, but nothing that required a doctor.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: No, I think that covers it. I just want to get back to normal.

Q: Understood. Thank you for your time. This concludes the statement.
